Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. Tender security must be submited from any e-GP Schedule bank in favour of Chairman KDA, Khulna.
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor in construction works of at least 1(One) contract(s) of the minimum
value of the similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully completed within the last 10 (Ten) years,
each with a value of at least Tk. 10 (Ten) Crore. Years counting back ward from the date of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
The Contractor must have the following experience in the above Mentioned or in other contract :
(i) Must have experience of Constructing high rise building [minimum 9 (nine) storied] with steel framed structure.
(ii) Should have experience of constructing composite structure of Steel and RCC
(iii) Should have experience of providing fire safety facilities of high rise building.
(iv) Must have experience of providing electro mechanical and plumbing facilities of high rise building.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 17 (Seventeen) Crore over the best three (3) years
in the last five (5) years. Payment certificates for contract in progress or completed under public sector during last 5 (five) years
must be submitted along with the tender in support of average annual construction turnover. Years counting back ward from the
date of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
4. Liquid assets/ working capital/credit facilities Tk 3 (Three) Crore.
5. The Tender Capacity is Tk. 14 (Fourteen) Crore. Supporting document must be submitted along with information as per
enclosed form (ongoing works/commitments)
6. The Tenderer must enclose up-to-date Trade license, Income Tax clearance certificate and VAT registration certificate.
7. Personnel Capacity & Equipment Capacity as per TDS.
(Drawings are attached in Corrigendum doc
Brief Description of Works : Construction of total 09 (nine) storied steel framed Building on existing 3 storied building with 9-storied foundation, including semi
